claims.statement: Binary Shannon entropy has a unique maximum at sigma = 1/2.
Exact cancellation of the normalized complementary two-channel state requires sigma = 1/2 and relative phase pi modulo 2pi.
The fixed set of s -> 1 - conjugate(s) is Re(s) = 1/2.
A canonical zeta-state map converts every non-trivial zeta zero into exact complementary cancellation.
Under SOH-C001 and the stated normalization and phase hypotheses, all non-trivial zeros lie on Re(s) = 1/2.
